display.purpose: KPI numbers and the page title — huge, tight, tabular. Never for prose.

label.purpose: Tracked-caps captions above KPI numbers and table headers.

mono.purpose: Every machine value: timestamps, IPs, ports, protocol/direction, error detail.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for every card — defines the edge instead of a border.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Hover state for cards and secondary buttons.

shadows.name: pill
shadows.purpose: Tighter shadow for small controls — fields, badges, date range, Stop.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The whole app sheet floating on the desk canvas.

shadows.name: apply
shadows.purpose: Cobalt primary button's resting contact shadow.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing — expo-out. Every authored transition, settle, and bar growth uses it.

motion.name: bar-grow
motion.purpose: Chart bars scaleY from the baseline; ranked-row widths grow at .6s.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Hover/press lift on pills and buttons (translateY -1px).

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: Whole motion language collapses to instant under reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: rail-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Two-column layout stacks; KPI grid drops to 3-up.

breakpoints.name: sheet-breakout
breakpoints.purpose: Sheet goes full-bleed (0 radius, 100vh); filter bar un-sticks; KPI grid 2-up; grid2 single column.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single saturated action (Apply). Cobalt fill, full pill, lifts 1px on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--cobalt, #2563eb); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 13px/1 var(--font, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); padding: 10px 20px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 5px 14px -7px rgba(18,20,28,.4); transition: transform .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .15s, background .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet white control (Stop, Reset, back pill). Hairline border, pill shadow, lifts to the Lift shadow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: var(--card, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--hair, #e8e8ee); color: var(--ink, #14161b); font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--font, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); padding: 9px 15px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(18,20,28,.10), 0 3px 8px -4px rgba(18,20,28,.14); transition: transform .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(18,20,28,.06), 0 24px 48px -20px rgba(18,20,28,.26); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Field
components.description: Inline pill field with a label sitting before the control; focus-within turns the border cobalt with a 14% ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--card, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--hair, #e8e8ee); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 14px; font: 500 13px/1 var(--font, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink-2, #5b616e); transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color: var(--cobalt, #2563eb); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37,99,235,.14); } .ds-field input { border: none; background: none; color: var(--ink, #14161b); font: 500 13px/1 var(--font, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); outline: none; padding: 0; min-width: 0; width: 110px; caret-color: var(--cobalt, #2563eb); }

components.name: Pill Navigation
components.description: Centered nav on a grey trough; the active item becomes a near-black pill with white text. Context pills (drill-down names) join the group with a dismiss ×.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 3px; background: #ececf1; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px; font-family: var(--font, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-nav button { border: none; background: none; color: var(--ink-2, #5b616e); font: 500 13.5px/1 var(--font, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: color .15s, background .15s; } .ds-nav button:hover { color: var(--ink, #14161b); } .ds-nav button.on { background: var(--nav, #15161a); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(18,20,28,.4); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cobalt, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status chip on white with a hairline border, pill shadow, and an optional cobalt live-dot; the emphasized half renders at 800.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--card, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--hair, #e8e8ee); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 600 12px/1 var(--font, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #14161b); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(18,20,28,.10), 0 3px 8px -4px rgba(18,20,28,.14); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge b { font-weight: 800; } .ds-badge .dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cobalt, #2563eb); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The content container: white, 20px radius, no border — the shadow defines the edge. Hoverable variant lifts 2px. Never nested.
components.html:
Top hosts 88 seen

Destinations contacted in range
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card, #fff); border: none; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(18,20,28,.05), 0 16px 36px -18px rgba(18,20,28,.18); padding: 20px 22px; font-family: var(--font, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); transition: transform .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .18s; } .ds-card.hoverable:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(18,20,28,.06), 0 24px 48px -20px rgba(18,20,28,.26); } .ds-card h4 { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.01em; margin: 0 0 2px; color: var(--ink, #14161b); } .ds-card .sub { color: var(--ink-2, #5b616e); font-size: 12.5px; margin: 0 0 14px; }

components.name: KPI Strip
components.description: Signature: tracked-caps label above a huge tabular number, cells split by 1px hairlines.
components.html: TOTAL CONNECTIONS4,762any app · any host
components.css: .ds-kpi { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 18px; border-left: 1px solid var(--hair, #e8e8ee); min-width: 0; font-family: var(--font, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-kpi:first-child { border-left: none; padding-left: 0; } .ds-kpi .lbl { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #878d9a); } .ds-kpi .val { font-size: clamp(21px, 2vw, 30px); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -.03em; color: var(--ink, #14161b); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kpi .note { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ink-3, #878d9a); }

components.name: Progress Row
components.description: Signature ranked-list row: mono rank, ellipsized name, tabular count, and a hatched pill bar whose ink identifies the series. The hatching (135° stripes) is the house chart style — never a flat fill.
components.css: .ds-row { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 26px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: none; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font, 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background .15s; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--hair-2, #f1f1f5); } .ds-row .rk { font: 500 11.5px/1 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--ink-3, #878d9a); text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row .nm { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #14161b); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-row:hover .nm { color: var(--cobalt, #2563eb); } .ds-row .ct { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2, #5b616e); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-row .bar { position: absolute; left: 44px; right: 10px; bottom: 3px; height: 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bar, #2563eb) 0 3px, color-mix(in srgb, var(--bar, #2563eb) 45%, #fff) 3px 6px); width: var(--w, 40%); transition: width .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }

narrative.overview:
PC Watcher's dashboard is a sheet of frosted paper laid on a cool grey desk. Everything the machine did is printed on that sheet in crisp black ink, sorted into soft white cards you could pick up. The aesthetic refuses two defaults: the incumbent's flat undifferentiated list page, and the monitoring-category cliché of dark dense tables with tiny type and glowing accent lines. It is bright, organized, and glanceable — one screen answers 'what talked, to whom, when' before any click.

The personality is calm confidence with a playful data hand. Structure is neutral and quiet; all the color energy is spent on the data itself, drawn in four hatched inks so a series is recognisable by texture as well as hue. The single saturated cobalt is rationed to things you can press.
keyCharacteristics: Cool light-grey canvas under a rounded white sheet that holds the whole app
Oversized black tabular-figure numbers above small tracked-caps labels
Hatched/striped data inks (cobalt, pink, emerald, amber) — never flat fills
Pill-shaped controls everywhere; one saturated action color, rationed
Hairline rules as the only dividers — no heavy borders, no nested cards

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Cobalt appears only on things you can press. Never a decorative background, never body text, never a chart fill on its own. If a surface is cobalt, clicking it does something.

rules.name: The Hatched Ink Rule
rules.body: Data series are drawn as 135° repeating-linear-gradient hatching, never flat color fills. A series keeps its one ink across every view, so color is learnable as identity.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: All numerals that can change or line up — KPI values, counts, ranks, timestamps, table numbers — use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Columns of numbers must align.

rules.name: The Offset-Blur Rule
rules.body: Every shadow carries a downward offset AND a soft blur with negative spread. A zero-offset halo is decoration and is not used.

dos: Do use tabular-nums on every numeral that can change or align
Do draw data series as 135° hatching in their one assigned ink, consistent across views
Do keep cobalt rationed to pressable things only
Do use minmax(0, 1fr) on every grid/flex track so long hostnames shrink instead of overflowing
Do separate groups with 1px hairlines and let shadows (not borders) define a card's edge
Do theme browser surfaces — selection tint, caret, scrollbar, focus ring — from the palette
donts: Don't nest cards or pad a card inside another card
Don't add a colored glow or a zero-offset halo shadow
Don't use a hard offset block shadow (4px 4px 0)
Don't fill a data series with flat color where hatching is the house style
Don't put a border-left/border-right accent stripe wider than 1px on a card
Don't render machine values (IPs, ports, timestamps, protocol) in the sans face — they are mono
Don't invent a second display face; the scale contrast is the personality
